name: Jin-Gitaxias
description: Jin-Gitaxias is the blue-aligned Phyrexian praetor of the Progress Engine on New Phyrexia, whose twisted sciences made the compleation of planeswalkers possible.

description_citations.text: "Jin-Gitaxias". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

summary.text: Jin-Gitaxias is the blue-aligned Phyrexian praetor of the Progress Engine on New Phyrexia, whose twisted sciences made the compleation of planeswalkers possible.

citations.text: "Jin-Gitaxias". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: When New Phyrexia rose he overtook Lumengrid, which became the capital of his Progress Engine, and turned conquered vedalken into a research library.

citations.text: "Vedalken", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Lumengrid", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: He rewrote the Phyrexian Scriptures as the Great Synthesis, took over the Surgical Bay as a domain of experimentation, and enhanced the glistening oil with blinkmoth serum.

bio.text: Elesh Norn challenged him to find a way to turn planeswalkers into Phyrexians, and on Kamigawa he experimented on kami and devised a way to compleat a planeswalker without removing the soul, killing Tameshi after getting what he needed from him.

citations.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Kaito and Tamiyo discovered his base and fought him, and the Wanderer cut him in half, but Tezzeret rebuilt him on New Phyrexia, where he compleated Tamiyo as the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

citations.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Tamiyo", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: He built Tezzeret a darksteel body and tried to bind him, but Tezzeret escaped.

citations.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Tezzeret", section "Phyrexia: All Will be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: During the invasion of the multiverse his army filled the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, and Norn tore off his arm when he advised against her plan.

bio.text: When Zhalfir took New Phyrexia's place he mutinied and turned his army on Norn, but Zhalfirin forces collapsed his war machine and his own newts devoured him.

citations.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When New Phyrexia rises, Jin-Gitaxias overtakes Lumengrid and turns conquered vedalken into a research library.
timeline.quote: Lumengrid was overtaken by the forces of Jin-Gitaxias

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Mirrodin/New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The infected Karn retreats to the core and the Panopticon becomes his throne; Jin-Gitaxias's servants hijack it.
timeline.quote: the Panopticon was converted into his throne

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias takes over the Fourth Sphere and drains the Quicksilver Sea into it.
timeline.quote: who drained the Quicksilver Sea above into it, creating a massive reservoir of glistening oil

citation.text: "Glistening oil", section "The Infection of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias enhances the oil with blinkmoth serum and learns to compleat planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: The praetor also discovered how to compleat planeswalkers with the oil

citation.text: "Glistening oil", section "The Infection of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Each color alignment gains a Praetor, factionalizing the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: each alignment gained a Praetor to oversee that color

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Factionalizing and the Castes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Mirrodin Tezzeret infiltrates the Phyrexian hierarchy, immune to phyresis, rising to sit beside Karn.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret established himself within the Phyrexian hierarchy without the compromise of undergoing compleation

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn's subpriest and Kraynox's archivist warn Karn about the Mirrans organizing and Jin-Gitaxias's disbelief and spies, urging action.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias does not believe in you,

citation.text: "Corrupted Conscience". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias converts the topmost chamber of Lumengrid into his laboratory to realize the Great Synthesis.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias dwells within the now fully Phyrexianized Lumengrid, and has converted the topmost chamber into his own personal laboratory and study.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias rewrites the Scriptures' Grand Evolution as the Great Synthesis, out of distaste for Vorinclex and Glissa's talk of evolution.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias has modified the Phyrexian Scriptures in their mentioning of "The Grand Evolution."

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias writes the Gitaxian Standard of Purity with ideas from discussions with Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Taking ideas from many lengthy discussions with Elesh Norn, the Gitaxian Standard of Purity gives Malcator and Uulbrek the basic rules and measures of compleation.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias engineers the skites to replace the inefficient vedalken homunculi.
timeline.quote: Judging the vedalken homunculi far too inefficient, Jin-Gitaxias engineered the skites to fulfill menial functions.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias organizes his laboratories into sectives under subpraetors.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias has organized his laboratories into "sectives," reminiscent of the vedalken sanctives.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias takes over the Surgical Bay and expands the oil reservoir.
timeline.quote: it was later taken over by Jin-Gitaxias, who drained the Quicksilver Sea above into it

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Spheres of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias compleats Tamiyo, the first Phyrexian planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo is compleated by Jin-Gitaxias , becoming the first Phyrexian planeswalker .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito encounters the monster who murdered Tameshi, who names himself Jin-Gitaxias and calls ninjas.
timeline.quote: The existence of a second Jin-Gitaxias on this plane is highly improbable

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito fights the Undercity ninjas and escapes the lab with a smoke bomb.
timeline.quote: Black smoke exploded through the crowd

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
timeline.quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
timeline.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: In the Phyrexian laboratory Tamiyo awakens Phyrexianized, loyal to Phyrexia and calling it her new family.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was her new home.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
timeline.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cuts Jin-Gitaxias out of the fight.
timeline.quote: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion.

citation.text: Wanderer's Intervention (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias covets planeswalking secrets and tests spirits.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias had long coveted the secrets of planeswalking.

citation.text: Planar Incision (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Kaito are unprepared for the praetor.
timeline.quote: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.

citation.text: Spell Pierce (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias dismisses a test, saying incompleat flesh is weak.
timeline.quote: A minor test, nothing more. Incompleat flesh is weak.

citation.text: Malicious Malfunction (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo charge into Jin-Gitaxias's lab, which he expected.
timeline.quote: Kaito and Tamiyo charged headlong into Jin-Gitaxias's secret lab, unaware that the praetor was eagerly awaiting their arrival.

citation.text: Explosive Entry (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer entrusts the Reality Chip to Tamiyo to keep it from Jin-Gitaxias.
timeline.quote: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.

citation.text: Tamiyo's Safekeeping (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn challenges Jin-Gitaxias to find a way to turn planeswalkers into Phyrexians; with Tezzeret he goes to Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: the praetor Elesh Norn challenged Jin-Gitaxias to find a way to turn planeswalkers into Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito Shizuki and Tamiyo discover his base and fight him; the Wanderer cuts him in half.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: where he compleated the kidnapped Tamiyo into the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

citation.text: "Jin-Gitaxias", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo fight Jin-Gitaxias and Tezzeret to protect the returned emperor and Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret transports Jin-Gitaxias to and from Kamigawa and kidnaps Tamiyo.

citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.
